name: morning-report
description: Accountability to your own goals: a daily status report written each night from your Claude Code sessions

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: Where the reports, your answers, priorities.md and profile.md live. ~ is your home folder.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: The model that summarizes each session. A cheap one is enough.

reportModel.title: Report model
reportModel.description: The model that writes the report from the summaries.

sessionLogsDir.title: Session logs folder
sessionLogsDir.description: Optional folder of <session-id>.md logs to read beside the transcripts. Empty skips it.

notifyCommand.title: Notify command
notifyCommand.description: Optional command run with one message argument when a report is ready or fails. Empty skips it.

launchCommand.title: Launch command
launchCommand.description: Optional command /morning-review runs to start a fast-track item in a new session, with {dir}, {name} and {prompt} filled in. Empty prints the prompts to paste.

gitCommit.title: Commit to git
gitCommit.description: When dataDir is a folder of a git repo, commit it and push after each run.

setupDays.title: Setup scan days
setupDays.description: How many days of sessions /morning-setup counts when it offers to read them, at most 7.

reportHour.title: Report hour
reportHour.description: The hour (0–19) /morning-setup schedule runs the report, then hourly for four hours to retry a failed run.
